logic_errors.summary: Malformed encoded engine output escapes the sanitized inventory failure boundary.
logic_errors.detail: subprocess.run(text=True) may raise UnicodeDecodeError while decoding either captured stdout or stderr. run_engine catches only OSError and TimeoutExpired; main catches only InventoryError. Both actual subprocess decoding probes raised UnicodeDecodeError out of main rather than returning 2 with the fixed sanitized unavailable message. Even unused stderr is decoded and can trigger this.
logic_errors.reproduction: Inject a subprocess.run wrapper at the first exact allowlisted container ls tuple. Delegate the same capture/text/check/shell/timeout options to an isolated local Python fixture that emits byte 0xff on stdout, then repeat for stderr. Neither fixture runs Docker or connects to a service.
logic_errors.observed: UnicodeDecodeError escaped main for both streams; no partial inventory printed. This is an error-handling defect, not mutation authorization or demonstrated secret disclosure.
logic_errors.recommended_fix: Translate subprocess UnicodeError decoding failures to the same sanitized InventoryError as other engine read failures, retaining strict decoding. Add adapter-through-CLI regression coverage for both streams. Do not broadly swallow arbitrary programming exceptions.

limits: Two matching projected observations do not establish an atomic snapshot, exclusive lock, continuous freeze, trusted ownership, or permission to mutate; mutation_authorized remains false.
Project/service/world labels are untrusted classification; foreign means project label mismatch, not cryptographic ownership.
Selected Go format omits environment and credentials. Captured mounts include source metadata, but public projection excludes raw label values and mount source/destination paths.

Inspect parser caps 262144 characters, not captured bytes or subprocess memory. List outputs have no byte cap. Up to 64 IDs per query and 128 union IDs per snapshot; no global end-to-end observation deadline beyond 10 seconds per command.

No Docker engine reads made by this reviewer. Existing-resource inspect, foreign users, command failures and drift verified through explicit fixtures; parent absence observation is not independently repeated and cannot establish live present-resource behavior.
No SQL, credential/runtime-secret inspection, reset execution, seeding, provisioning, gameplay, ownership certification, or combined population/chat/core acceptance.
PATH-resolved docker and the configured engine endpoint are ambient trusted operator dependencies; the allowlist controls arguments, not executable provenance.
No baseline stash/reset, dependency refresh, network audit, whole-repository coverage, or full check performed in the concurrently modified working tree.
